guarantees.claim: tx_watermark_thresh gets the value 1'b1 left-shifted by uart_fifo_txilvl when uart_fifo_txilvl is less than (TxFifoDepthW-2).
tx_watermark_thresh gets the value TxFifoDepth/2, cast to TxFifoDepthW, when uart_fifo_txilvl is greater than or equal to (TxFifoDepthW-2).
event_tx_watermark is always true when tx_fifo_depth is less than tx_watermark_thresh, false otherwise.

uncertain_points.claim: The saturation condition (uart_fifo_txilvl >= TxFifoDepthW-2) assumes TxFifoDepthW is the bit width of TxFifoDepth (e.g., $clog2(TxFifoDepth)). If TxFifoDepthW is defined incorrectly elsewhere, the threshold may saturate at a wrong point, causing the watermark event to trigger too early or too late.
uncertain_points.cond: TxFifoDepthW and TxFifoDepth in the module hierarchy
uncertain_points.risk: event_tx_watermark may not accurately reflect the intended half-FIFO watermark, leading to missed or false watermark events that affect UART flow control.
